title: Meme Mania
description: An action-packed 3D endless runner packed with viral meme characters (Doge, Gigachad, Pepe, Popcat, Wojak, Capybara), wild power-ups, procedural meme sound effects, and 100% 60FPS Three.js kinematics.

controls.desktop: WASD / Arrow Keys to dodge, jump, and slide. Space to jump.
controls.mobile: On-screen steering pad & jump/slide buttons, or swipe gestures.
